data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add a fan-in detector to /dso:preplanning computed against the union of the depends_on graph and the cross_story_signals graph (the edges draft-3's critic derives). It requires an integration story when (a) any node has fan-in >= 2 in either graph, OR (b) any cross_story_signals edge exists at all. The required integration story's Done Definition references an orchestrator-entry fixture exercising producer -> consumer -> artifact through /dso:brainstorm or /dso:preplanning.
**Why**: The f360 defect was a 1:1 coupling that a fan-in >= 2 threshold would miss; condition (b) catches it. Integration coverage is the gate that would have caught the producer/consumer mismatch end-to-end.
**Scope**:
- IN: union-graph construction from depends_on and cross_story_signals; the two-condition trigger; the integration-story requirement; the orchestrator-entry fixture reference in the integration story's Done Definition.
- OUT: the cross-story edge derivation itself (draft-3 owns it); sprint Phase E changes; the regression fixture family (draft-6).

## Done Definitions

- /dso:preplanning constructs a union graph from the depends_on edges and the cross_story_signals edges of the drafted story set ← Satisfies: sc-3
- The detector requires an integration story when any node has fan-in >= 2 in either the depends_on graph or the cross_story_signals graph ← Satisfies: sc-3
- The detector requires an integration story when any cross_story_signals edge exists, including a 1:1 coupling ← Satisfies: sc-3
- The required integration story's Done Definition references an orchestrator-entry fixture exercising producer -> consumer -> artifact through /dso:brainstorm or /dso:preplanning ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including a 1:1-edge case that triggers the requirement and a zero-edge zero-fan-in case that does not ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Threshold] Condition (b) fires on a single signal edge; do not regress it to >= 2, which was the original red-team-flagged miss.
- [Coupling] The cross_story_signals graph is the set of edges draft-3's check (c) derives; consume that output rather than re-deriving edges.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want /dso:preplanning to require an integration story whenever the union of depends_on and cross_story_signals graphs shows fan-in or any signal edge, so that every cross-story coupling gets integration coverage.
